objective: Restore legacy and newly attached video cards in Cluster/Organization/Sub-organization Community scope feeds, with safe signed URL recovery and no changes to ad/video lifecycles.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only production database check on 2026-11-18 confirmed the screenshot posts created 2026-11-16 18:25:02 and 18:25:33 UTC have a matching single video sidecar each and an existing community-media Storage object; latest exact Android production/OTA fingerprint not validated in this DEV PR. This branch must not be claimed deployed.
chosenApproach: Use the existing authorized hydrated community_post_media row for media URL, poster and player rather than requiring the legacy top-level media_url. Preserve top-level fallback for old posts; show an on-demand retry tile when signing fails; rotate authorized signed URLs with bounded attempts and stale scope guards.
selectionRationale: The scoped Media loader already securely hydrates the attachments and the viewability hook already detects them; the card and its URL recovery handler were the mismatched consumers. A scoped UI fix avoids backend changes, duplicate video players, offscreen downloads and new dependencies.

alternativeApproaches: Copy media_items URL into top-level post fields during hydration: rejected because it would conflate legacy and sidecar identity and could overwrite stale signed URLs.
Modify Supabase social feed RPC to sign every video eagerly: rejected due database/backend risk, slower initial paint and needless signing for offscreen feed rows.
Selected: resolve the existing authorized sidecar row in the scoped renderer, preserving legacy fallback, viewability and on-demand URL refresh.
